column1: # scripts/mustload-budgets.tsv — frozen per-archetype MUST-LOAD token-est
# ceilings for .claude/skills/deep-code-review/SKILL.md's "Archetype -> load
# map" table (dogfoods the same freeze-ratchet policy as
# scripts/size-budgets.tsv, enforced by `scripts/ci-gates.sh mustload`).
# POLICY = FREEZE-RATCHET. Each ceiling below is the archetype's CURRENT
# must-load token-est total (chars/4 per file, summed across its MUST-LOAD
# refs — matching .claude/skills/deep-code-review/references/
# skill-authoring-and-size.md's "a token estimate of chars/4 is enough") at
# the moment this config was adopted — not an aspirational target. The gate
# is GREEN today by construction. From here, a ceiling moves in exactly one
# direction: DOWN, as P1b splits/trims the archetype's must-load refs into
# smaller routed sub-files. Raising a ceiling to let a bloated ref grow
# defeats the point.
# This is the FIRST time that cost was made visible: the `web` archetype
# alone carries a ~93K-token must-load tax (security-appsec.md +
# frontend-a11y.md + product-ux-quality.md) before a web-archetype review
# reads one line of project code — now measured and frozen, not free to grow
# further, and a P1b split has a concrete number to reduce.
# FORMAT: one row per archetype, `<archetype, exactly as SKILL.md's load-map
# table names it>\t<max tokens>`, plus `phase-conditional\t<ref>.md` rows
# (see PHASE-FLOOR FOLLOW-UP below). Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are
# ignored. Every archetype row in SKILL.md's load map must have exactly one
# row here (fail closed: an archetype on disk with no row, or a row whose
# archetype no longer exists in the load map, is a gate failure — see
# scripts/ci-gates.sh cmd_mustload). This does NOT replace the coverage floor
# (cmd_enumeration / cmd_routing's routed-reference check) — no ref is ever
# dropped to satisfy a ceiling, only measured. Two rows, `phase-floor-light`
# and `phase-floor-full`, are a separate namespace (not archetype names) for
# the Phase 0-2 mandatory floor below — both are required, fail closed if
# either is missing.
# P1b split (context-split change): security-appsec.md's API-specific
# overlay moved to security-api.md (must-load for `api / service` only; read
# on trigger by any archetype that serves its own API), and
# product-ux-quality.md's parity-claim sections moved to rendered-parity.md
# (read on a port / restyle / design-parity task). Every ceiling below was
# re-pinned to its new total: web 93463->86836, mobile 33070->28778,
# agent / LLM / MCP 38008->33716, data / ETL 29582->29581, lib / SDK
# 10926->10913, IaC / platform unchanged. ONE deliberate rise:
# `api / service` 33516->33573 (+57 tokens, +0.2%) — the new file's required
# title and "Read this when" line plus the parent's one-line pointer; that
# archetype still loads all of the same content, now across two files.
# PHASE 0-2 MANDATORY FLOOR (`phase-floor-light` / `phase-floor-full` rows,
# below): the refs every review loads regardless of archetype — SKILL.md's
# own bytes (read to reach the table at all) + every backtick-quoted ref
# named in SKILL.md's "| Phase | Does | Load |" table's phase 0/1/2 rows.
# `phase-floor-light` = SKILL.md + method.md + testing-and-evals.md +
# language-stack-redflags.md + domain-checklists.md (loaded on every scope).
# `phase-floor-full` adds branch-and-merge-hygiene.md, the one ref phase
# 0's Load column marks "on FULL". cmd_mustload parses that table live
# (never a second hardcoded copy of the list) and fails closed if the
# section is missing/unparseable or a named ref isn't on disk. Same
# freeze-ratchet direction as the per-archetype rows: DOWN only, as the
# mandatory set is trimmed/split.
# PHASE-FLOOR SPLIT (phase-floor cut): the five Phase 0-2 refs kept only
# what every review needs and moved conditional depth into routed sub-files,
# each loaded on an explicit trigger: language-stack-redflags.md -> one
# lang-*.md per language family present; domain-checklists.md -> an index
# over one domain-<letter>.md per applicable domain; testing-and-evals.md ->
# testing-ui.md / testing-ai-evals.md / testing-ml.md; method.md ->
# method-situational.md (a "when"-qualified conditional ref in the phase
# table, which cmd_mustload excludes from the floor but existence-checks);
# branch-and-merge-hygiene.md -> merge-operations.md. SKILL.md's duplicated
# role table was removed to pay for the new routes (role-coverage.md already
# holds the same table with more columns). Floors re-pinned: phase-floor-light 65903->35786, phase-floor-full
# 87137->47350. No archetype row rose; each re-pinned down to its current
# total (repointed cross-references, plus 3 tokens of slack already present on
# web, mobile, api / service, and agent / LLM / MCP): web 86836->86823,
# agent / LLM / MCP 33716->33705, IaC / platform 4342->4339, lib / SDK
# PHASE-FLOOR FOLLOW-UP (review fixes on the split): the floor pins are now an
# EXACT-EQUALITY ratchet -- cmd_mustload fails when a floor total is above its
# pin (shrink the refs) AND when it is below it (re-pin the row down), so a cut
# is locked in by the commit that makes it. The Phase 0-2 refs allowed to
# carry the " when " qualifier are pinned explicitly as `phase-conditional
# <TAB><ref>.md` rows (the only non-numeric rows): a " when " ref with no pin,
# a pinned ref the phase table also names unconditionally, and a pin the
# table no longer names each fail closed, so re-qualifying a floor ref as
# conditional can never drop it from the floor silently. Deliberate floor
# rise: phase-floor-light 35786->35858 (+72), phase-floor-full 47350->47452
# (+102). It comes from one restored always-on method.md line (check a gate
# against its cited standard and run it twice), the widened shell and SQL
# load triggers in language-stack-redflags.md, and cross-file pointers that
# replaced bare "above" or section-5 references to content moved to
# lang-*.md, method-situational.md, and merge-operations.md. Archetype rows
# re-pinned down to their current totals: web 86823->86820, mobile
# 28775->28772, api / service 33566->33563, agent / LLM / MCP
# WEB SPLIT (web must-load cut): frontend-a11y.md and product-ux-quality.md
# kept only what every web review needs and moved conditional depth into
# routed sub-files, each indexed in its parent with a concrete trigger.
# frontend-a11y.md keeps the design-respect rule, the base WCAG 2.2 AA
# checklist per family, the WCAG 2.2 additions, usability, cross-view
# consistency, URL-backed state, the server/client boundary, the Core Web
# Vitals thresholds, browser security, and the closing grep; its depth moved
# to a11y-aria.md, a11y-live.md, a11y-focus.md, a11y-color-motion.md,
# a11y-forms.md, web-fetch.md, and web-render.md. product-ux-quality.md keeps
# the read-first stance, every data state, encoding and colour-alone,
# self-evidence and density, the named-standard rule, the grep, and the
# pre-ship checklist; its depth moved to ux-writes.md, ux-dataviz.md,
# ux-lists.md, ux-components.md, ux-interaction.md, ux-sweep.md, and
# ux-gates.md. The WCAG section was first re-tagged from bold run-in labels
# to ### headings (byte-identical) so the split follows real sections. Paid
# for in SKILL.md by dropping the redundant `references/` prefix from bare
# names the tables already use unqualified, so SKILL.md shrank (23967 ->
# (repointed cross-references in data-quality.md and performance-db-cost.md);
# every other archetype row unchanged at its exact total. Floors:
# phase-floor-light 35858->35846, phase-floor-full 47452->47440.
